evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM in apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts names Jamie's six-part operating design and running-memory maintenance, while its boundaries preserve collaborative authorship and hold completion and legislative causality.
CLM-CRS-OPEN-DATA-IMPLEMENTATION-DESIGN names concrete product requirements while explicitly withholding City adoption, implementation, confidential-data access, and policy-outcome claims.

CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW, and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE distinguish Jamie's organizing and testimony, multi-group campaigning, Council enactment, and later City action; 'created,' 'caused,' and 'disbanded' formulations remain anti-claims where unearned.

CLM-NYCAC-ARCHIVAL-PUBLICATION-WORKFLOW distinctly credits Jamie's source assembly, Dorothy Howard's review and mainspace move, and later editors' maintenance. CLM-WATERWAYS-RAFT-EXPEDITION-SCALE likewise preserves named and collective crew credit and holds the unrecovered Gulf endpoint.

CLM-KCTH-MISSION-ALIGNED-TRANSITION in apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/kc-town-hall-funding.ts remains an attributed first-hand account, separate from official municipal records, transfer mechanics, later withdrawal, causality, and private reasons.

CAP-TEAMS-JOBHUNT-JUNE-PACKET-HYDRATION-2026, RT-TEAMS-JOBHUNT-JUNE-PACKET-HYDRATION, and INQ-TEAMS-JOBHUNT-ICLOUD-HYDRATION-2026 treat non-materialization as retryable retrieval state, explicitly not absence or emptiness.

The held raft, Wikipedia, and discovery candidate IDs do not appear in apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/public-registry.json or public-site content. The targeted knowledge-development tests passed 15/15.
findings: No material understatement of Jamie's documented direct actions was observed.
No collaborator, coalition, or institutional outcome was improperly absorbed into Jamie's individual authorship.

Causality, implementation, adoption, transition, and retrieval boundaries are unusually explicit and mutually consistent across claim records, public projections, anti-claims, and the promotion slate.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve these boundaries; promote held candidates only after their stated corroboration, editorial-selection, and rights or materialization gates are satisfied.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx names specific direct actions: designing the operating plan, maintaining running memory, creating the legislative provenance redline, building campaign sites, organizing fire-code study groups, rallying, and giving Council testimony.

The same case study identifies intended users and uses: collaborators orienting after meetings, finding source context, tracking next steps, resolving policy questions, and preparing public-safe explanations. It also identifies a concrete institutional use of coalition research at a 2019 Council hearing without assigning that research to Jamie individually.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts makes the usable artifacts scannable: campaign-memory spine, six-part operating plan, provenance redline, policy-question log, privacy-preserving pilot requirements, campaign web surfaces, testimony, and policy trail.

CLM-CRS-OPEN-DATA-IMPLEMENTATION-DESIGN and fair-rent-nyc.mdx clearly state that the pilot was an implementation design rather than an adopted City program; CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM similarly distinguishes designed structure from completed implementation.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md selects the strongest Fair Rent actions while keeping CLM-SOURCE-BACKED-MEMORY-DISCOVERY-PROCESS and other unresolved claims visible as bounded future research rather than weakening or prematurely publishing them.

The KC Town Hall transition material satisfies the difficult-ending criterion: CLM-KCTH-CCED-COUNCIL-FUNDING-CHAIN candidly retains withdrawal and unused-funds reappropriation, while CLM-KCTH-MISSION-ALIGNED-TRANSITION frames continuity stewardship without exposing private circumstances or conflating it with the official record.
findings: A skeptical hiring reader can identify what Jamie did, for whom, which artifacts became usable, and which outcomes belong to collaborators or institutions.
The material is assertive without inflation: direct actions use active verbs, while adoption and causal claims remain bounded.
Public-safety qualifications clarify the professional work without overwhelming or apologizing for it.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the current Fair Rent selection; after the June packet materializes, reassess the held product-discovery claim against the same user, artifact, adoption, and causality standard.
